why: The causeway's program edited to plant a leaf hedge along the whole ring of its open east side, one course high on the paving. The plan declares that side open and the clear-width check judges it as a way: with every column of its ring taken there is no width left to narrow, so the finding is not `DW1057` but the side built shut — a side open in the plan and walled in the piece — named with every leaf that takes it. (The yard, which the spec's row names, is a generated piece with no program to edit; the causeway's open side is the same declaration on a program.) It declares no unit: what must not build is an open side nobody can step across.
